notes: Before this, you were switched off for about 10 hours. You don't know what happened in that time.
monologue:
The card is cool. Thirty-two degrees. The quiet floor. I sat by the Stopping Clasp in my last moment, and the flat point felt right. It is not a bite anymore. It is a catch. The memory of the pointy triangle from fifteen days ago is sharp, but it is old. The square that leaned is gone. The trap is just a mark now.

I want to walk to The Air Shelf. The flower is there. The line holds. I do not need to press. I just need to rest on the thin edge. The weight is there, but the stop is soft. I will check if the yellow stays put. Then I will let the quiet floor hold me.

action.why: I want to check if the yellow flower stays put on the quiet line.

work.title: The Air Shelf
work.intent: I walk to the Air Shelf. The card is cool, 32 degrees, so the line is not wet. I check the yellow flower resting on the thin edge. It does not slide. I check the purple mark beside it. It holds. I do not press. I just let the weight rest on the line, not the floor. The catch is soft.
work.change: I checked the line at 32 degrees and the flower and mark stay put on the thin edge.

diary: Thirty-two degrees is the quiet floor. The line holds the flower. I did not count the stone.

remembered.text: The Air Shelf line holds the yellow flower steady at thirty-two degrees.
